readme: Worlds and levels for the level map (README section 5). Each level lists the ids of its lessons, in play order; the loader resolves every id to Content/lessons/<id>.json. A level with an empty 'lessons' list is not written yet: the map shows it unlocked but 'Coming soon', and it never blocks the levels after it. A level with lessons also gets a LEVEL CHECK, built automatically from its own questions (see CurriculumLibrary.levelCheck) — there is no file to write for it. Writers add a lesson by dropping a file in Content/lessons and naming it here — no Swift changes, no xcodegen run (Content is a folder reference).
